analogy.rationale: IKK inhibitors block IKBKB/CHUK in the NF-kB pathway, so NFkB pathway inhibitors should share the strongest transcriptional signature; the annotated off-targets (CDK2, CHEK1, GSK3B, KDR, PDK1) make kinase inhibitors partially similar, but the primary effect in these cell lines is expected to be weak because NF-kB activation is modest under basal conditions.
